# Frontend Routing

- Use `td-frontend-dev` as the frontend workflow entrypoint.
- Reuse the locked stack in `docs/StackProfile.md`.
- Apply `fe-base-rules`, `fe-vue-dev`, and `fe-vue-element-plus`.
- Activate `fe-axios-dev` only when the project moves from mock data to a real API.
- Keep module components under `src/modules/<module>/components/<ComponentName>/`.
